description_for_human: Governed Privacy Office tools for guidance, incident intake, PIA/DPIA/TRA/TIA/AIIA initiation, vendor status, policy search, JRAE applicability, and approval routing.
description_for_model: Use this plugin whenever an employee, privacy analyst, DPO, or legal counsel requests privacy guidance, checks vendor DPA/BAA/SCC approval status, reports a suspected privacy incident, initiates a privacy assessment (PIA, DPIA, TRA, TIA, LIA, AIIA), searches tenant privacy policies, evaluates multi-jurisdictional regulatory applicability (US, Canada, EU), or routes an approval decision. All calls require verified tenant_id and Entra ID Bearer token propagation.

functions.name: get_privacy_guidance
functions.description: Governed Privacy Office Assistant: identifies the employee's organization, applicable US/Canada/EU legal obligations, internal company policies, vendor approval status, required assessments, and approval gates before responding.

functions.name: report_privacy_incident
functions.description: Intake a suspected privacy or security incident. Creates a draft incident record and triage task for DPO/Legal review; never auto-dispatches external regulator notices.

confirmation.title: Confirm Privacy Incident Intake
confirmation.body: Submit this suspected privacy incident to the KIBO Privacy Office triage queue for DPO and Legal review?

functions.name: initiate_privacy_assessment
functions.description: Initiate a governed Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA), DPIA, Quebec/Canadian Transfer Risk Assessment (TRA), EU Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA), Legitimate Interests Assessment (LIA), or AI Impact Assessment (AIIA).

confirmation.title: Confirm Privacy Assessment Initiation
confirmation.body: Create a new draft privacy assessment in KIBO Privacy OS and assign the required reviewers?

functions.name: lookup_privacy_tasks
functions.description: Look up open privacy tasks, DSAR deadlines, breach readiness tasks, and assessment reviews scoped strictly to the authenticated tenant.

functions.name: lookup_vendor_status
functions.description: Look up a third-party vendor or AI subprocessor's privacy governance status, including executed DPA, HIPAA BAA, EU SCCs, Quebec Law 25 TRA, subprocessor list, and risk tier.

functions.name: search_privacy_policies
functions.description: Search tenant-scoped internal privacy policies, data handling standards, AI usage policies, and retention schedules.

functions.name: evaluate_regulatory_applicability
functions.description: Run the Jurisdictional Regulatory Applicability Engine (JRAE) across US Federal & 50 States, Canada Federal & 13 Provinces/Territories, and EU 27 Member States.

functions.name: route_approval_decision
functions.description: Route a consequential privacy workflow item (PIA/DPIA sign-off, vendor onboarding, cross-border transfer, or incident notification draft) to DPO/CPO/Legal for human approval.

confirmation.title: Confirm Approval Routing
confirmation.body: Route this item to the designated DPO / Legal Counsel approval queue with an immutable audit log entry?
